lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Steel hitting ground
Hard sonic sound
Pressure is high
Reach for the sky
[chorus]
Iron pulse beating fast
Built to conquer and to last
Feel the rhythm in the dark
Set the metal world to spark
[verse]
Engine screams loud
Out of the crowd
Burning the track
Never look back
[chorus]
Iron pulse beating fast
Built to conquer and to last
Feel the rhythm in the dark
Set the metal world to spark
[bridge]
Break the silence
Raise the violence
Heavy weight now
Take the final bow
[chorus]
Iron pulse beating fast
Built to conquer and to last
Feel the rhythm in the dark
Set the metal world to spark
[outro]
